    static int T2(ReadOnlySpan<char> text, int p)

    static int T1(ReadOnlySpan<char> text, int p)
    {
        p = MatchIdStart(text, p);
        if (p < 0) return -1;
        p = T2(text, p);
        if (p < 0) return -1;
        return p;

        new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "=" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(4, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair5 = new(3, "Expr",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(4, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair6 = new(4, "';'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(4, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair7 = new(1, "Identifier",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair8 = new(2, "';'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair9 = new(1, "'{'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "{" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair10 = new(3, "'}'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static bool P3(ref ParserState s)
    {
        s.Open(SyntaxKinds.List);
        while (true)
        {
            var m = s.Mark();
            s.SkipTrivia();
            int before = s.Position;
            if (!ParseItem(ref s) || s.Position == before)
            {
                s.Reset(m);
                if (s.Recovering && s.RecoverInList(s_repair10)) continue;
                break;
            }
        }
        s.Close();
        return true;
    }

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair11 = new(1, "GenName",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair12 = new(2, "';'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "}" }, new string[] { "block", "gen", "let", "use" }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair13 = new(1, "'$'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchNumber }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "$" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchNumber }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair14 = new(2, "Number",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchNumber }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair15 = new(1, "'('",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(1, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { "(" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
        });

    static bool P4(ref ParserState s)
    {
        s.Open(SyntaxKinds.List);
        if (s.ParseExtensible(Instance.Expr, 0))
        {
            while (true)
            {
                var m = s.Mark();
                s.SkipTrivia();
                if (!s.MatchLiteral(","))
                {
                    s.Reset(m);
                    break;
                }
                s.SkipTrivia();
                if (!s.ParseExtensible(Instance.Expr, 0))
                {
                    s.Reset(m);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        s.Close();
        return true;
    }

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair16 = new(3, "')'",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")", "+", ",", ".", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(3, new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false)),
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair17 = new(2, "Identifier",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")", "+", ",", ".", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier }, false)),
        });

    static readonly RepairSite s_repair18 = new(2, "Expr",
        new LookaheadSet(new string[] { ")", "+", ",", ".", ";" }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] {  }, false),
        new SyncPoint[]
        {
            new SyncPoint(2, new LookaheadSet(new string[] {  }, new string[] {  }, new delegate*<ReadOnlySpan<char>, int, int>[] { &MatchIdentifier, &MatchNumber }, false)),
        });
}

public static class ScopesKinds
{
    public static readonly int IdStart = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LIdStart);
    public static readonly int IdPart = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LIdPart);
    public static readonly int Identifier = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LIdentifier);
    public static readonly int Number = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LNumber);
    public static readonly int File = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LFile);
    public static readonly int Unit = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LUnit);
    public static readonly int Let = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LLet);
    public static readonly int Use = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LUse);
    public static readonly int Block = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LBlock);
    public static readonly int Gen = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LGen);
    public static readonly int GenName = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LGenName);
    public static readonly int Num = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LNum);
    public static readonly int Ref = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LRef);
    public static readonly int Call = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LCall);
    public static readonly int Member = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LMember);
    public static readonly int Add = ScopesModule.Kind(ScopesModule.LAdd);
}

public readonly struct ExprNode : ISyntaxView<ExprNode>
{
    public ExprNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public int Kind => Tree.Kind(Index);

    public T As<T>() where T : struct, ISyntaxView<T> => SyntaxView.Cast<T>(Tree, Index);

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => true;

    public static ExprNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct FileNode : ISyntaxView<FileNode>
{
    public FileNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public SyntaxList<UnitNode> Units => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == ScopesKinds.File;

    public static FileNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct UnitNode : ISyntaxView<UnitNode>

}

public abstract class ScopesVisitor<TResult>
{
    public virtual TResult Visit(SyntaxTree tree, int node)
    {
        int kind = tree.Kind(node);
        if (SyntaxKinds.ModuleOf(kind) == ScopesModule.Instance.Id)
        {
            switch (SyntaxKinds.LocalOf(kind))
            {
                case ScopesModule.LFile: return VisitFile(new FileNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LUnit: return VisitUnit(new UnitNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LLet: return VisitLet(new LetNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LUse: return VisitUse(new UseNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LBlock: return VisitBlock(new BlockNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LGen: return VisitGen(new GenNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LGenName: return VisitGenName(new GenNameNode(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LNum: return VisitNum(new NumExpr(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LRef: return VisitRef(new RefExpr(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LCall: return VisitCall(new CallExpr(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LMember: return VisitMember(new MemberExpr(tree, node));
                case ScopesModule.LAdd: return VisitAdd(new AddExpr(tree, node));
            }
        }
        return DefaultVisit(tree, node);
    }

    public TResult Visit<TView>(TView view) where TView : struct, ISyntaxView<TView> => Visit(view.Tree, view.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitFile(FileNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitUnit(UnitNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitLet(LetNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitUse(UseNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitBlock(BlockNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitGen(GenNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitGenName(GenNameNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitNum(NumExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitRef(RefExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitCall(CallExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitMember(MemberExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAdd(AddExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    protected virtual TResult DefaultVisit(SyntaxTree tree, int node) => default!;
}
